paragraphs.text: Doco is Killian Lu 's avian inkling familiar on the plane of Arcavios .

Doco, Killian Lu 's inkling , is an empathetic and supportive creature formed from black ink. He has onyx skin that swims with the text of the books he inhabits. Doco shows unwavering loyalty and the ability to help Killian in various ways.
After the New Phyrexian Invasion , Silverquill mages updated the inklings so they were less reminiscent of glistening oil . After the change, Doco took on an avian form.

Doco emerged from the book Quintorius Kand gave Killian, offering an empathetic simper to lift Killian's spirits when he was feeling down. Doco turned to a page in the book with hand signals and words of affirmation, helping Killian focus his intention and create light, demonstrating Doco's role in guiding Killian towards positive action.

When Killian contemplated joining Fannessa Fjyorne and the Oriq , Doco intervened by writing "We don't destroy. We create" in the air, helping Killian to reject the dark path. During the final battle, Doco transformed into various shapes and symbols to aid Killian in his spellcasting. His actions helped Killian to effectively counter the mage hunters, blind them, and ultimately lead to their defeat.
Doco's presence and actions symbolize the power of creation and light over destruction and darkness, reinforcing Killian's growth and decision to embrace his true nature.

Doco did not appear while Killian joined Zimone Wola , Rootha Squallheart , Quintorius Kand , and Dina in the search for the Invocation of the Founders during the New Phyrexian Invasion . However, he accompanied Killian on his work study at the Forum of Amity three years after the Invasion.
